figurative_meaning_en: To become indolent or lose enthusiasm in a task
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অফিসের কাজে কোমর ভাঙা শুরু করেছে।
পড়াশোনায় কোমর ভাঙার পর তার ফলাফল খারাপ হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has started slacking off in his office work.
After losing enthusiasm in studies, his results suffered.
note: This idiom metaphorically refers to ceasing physical or mental effort, evoking images of hard labor in Bengali rural life.
